guardrail: This tranche does not mutate the canonical P6 field registry and does not certify internal writable, computed, or storage semantics.

fields.semantic: Planned total cost through activity completion; planned labor + nonlabor + expense cost.
Earned value cost = BAC * performance percent complete; BAC comes from the project baseline.
EAC = actual total cost + estimate to complete cost; ETC method depends on WBS earned-value technique.
ETC is either remaining total cost or PF * (BAC - earned value), depending on the WBS earned-value technique.
Actual total cost / at-completion total cost * 100; constrained to 0..100.
Actual total cost / baseline planned total cost * 100; value may exceed 100.
Earned value divided by actual cost.
Performance percent complete used for earned value; method depends on the WBS earned-value technique.
Schedule percent complete relative to the selected project baseline and data date; 0 before baseline start and 100 after baseline finish.
Planned value cost = BAC * schedule percent complete as of the project data date.
Remaining total cost = remaining labor cost + remaining nonlabor cost + remaining expense cost.
Sum of remaining labor units and remaining nonlabor units.
Work remaining for labor resources; before start equals planned labor units and after completion is zero.
Work remaining for nonlabor resources; before start equals planned nonlabor units and after completion is zero.
Remaining float = late finish - remaining finish; when remaining finish equals early finish it generally matches total float.
Earliest possible date the remaining work can begin, computed by the scheduler from network logic, constraints, and resource availability.
Remaining late start date calculated by the scheduler.
Remaining late finish date calculated by the scheduler.
Primary project-baseline planned total cost; includes labor, nonlabor, and project expense costs.
Primary baseline start; equals planned start until activity starts, then actual start.

source: Oracle P6 EPPM REST API Release 26 Activity Read/Update documentation
